purpose: Screen official debt-service sources relevant to the household-consumption and credit-risk mechanisms without constructing a synthetic debt-service variable or estimating any behavioural equation.

bis_sectoral_dsr.current_dataset_scope: The current BIS DSR overview states that total private-non-financial-sector DSRs cover 32 economies, while household and NFC breakdowns are estimated for 17 economies.
bis_sectoral_dsr.consequence: No BIS household or NFC sector DSR may be treated as an exact Romania source. A total-PNFS DSR, if available for Romania, would still not be definitionally interchangeable with a household or NFC sector burden.

bnr_household_dsti.concept: Debt service-to-income (DSTI) for household borrowers / loan portfolios

evidence.finding: The report publishes quarterly household DSTI charts and states that in 2024 Q1 the average DSTI was 34 percent for new household loans and 41 percent for outstanding loans.
The report publishes a historical DSTI chart for new consumer and housing loans and discusses changes after the 2019 borrower-based limit.

semantic_boundary: Borrower/loan-portfolio DSTI is not the BIS macro flow-to-flow DSR for the full household sector.
New-loan DSTI is an origination-state measure and cannot stand in for debt service on the outstanding household debt stock.
Outstanding-loan DSTI is closer to the desired burden concept but remains a bank-loan borrower measure, not total household debt service divided by aggregate household income.
BNR DSTI may become an observed alternative state variable only under a separately frozen candidate-family measurement contract.
bnr_household_dsti.provider_note: BNR XLS/XLSX links are publicly indexed but current direct provider access is rejected in this environment; no chart digitisation is permitted.

shared_prohibitions: Do not construct a Romania household or NFC DSR from debt stock, a new-business rate and an assumed maturity.
Do not use household debt-to-income as debt service.
Do not use a regulatory DSTI cap as an observed time series.
Do not substitute BNR new-loan DSTI for an aggregate household debt-service burden.
Do not digitise report charts to manufacture a canonical time series.
Do not drop the debt-service term merely because the exact registered concept is unavailable.

household_consumption_response.next_gate: Enumerate and retain an exact BNR household DSTI history from official XLS/XLSX or another machine-readable official source, separately for new and outstanding loans where available; then preregister whether outstanding-loan DSTI defines a new borrower-burden candidate family.

credit_risk_npl_response.next_gate: Do not use household DSTI as the debt-service variable for aggregate NPL risk. Reopen only with a debt-service measure aligned to the chosen borrower/portfolio boundary.
